03: Every status bucket seeded; markdown in replies; phone tab bar.

13: Every rail tool is now live: Tasks (the session's plan and subagents), Plugins (installed with enable toggles, catalog with install and capability notice), Companion (notebook and a text line). Mock sessions have no plan, so Tasks shows its empty state.
